decisions.description: The decision register files and the lifecycle profile that the ADR governance checks read. Left out when no register is configured (additive, schemaVersion stays 1.1).

views.description: One result for each declared view, sorted by view ID. Left out when the workspace declares no view (additive, schemaVersion stays 1.1).

decisionSummary.description: The per-decision detail of the adrGovernance area. Left out when no register is configured (additive, schemaVersion stays 1.1).

trust.description: The boundary crossings of the relationships, flow steps and observed flows. Left out when no node, relationship or binding declares a trust value (additive, schemaVersion stays 1.1).

assessmentCurrency.description: The currency of every assessment version and required assessment (design D13 of add-review-currency). Left out when the run does not evaluate assessments (additive, schemaVersion stays 1.1).

governance.description: The relaxations of the review configuration against the trust anchor and the dispositions of removed subjects. Left out with assessmentCurrency (additive).

analysis.description: How the review evaluation ran and how complete it was. Left out with assessmentCurrency (additive).

assurance.description: The rendered sources, plans, statements, lineage, effective-policy evaluations, check results, and quality scenarios of the run. Left out without an `assurance` key in the workspace (additive, schemaVersion stays 1.1). Every list is sorted.

qualityLink.description: One `addressedBy` link of a scenario or finding. Only `active` counts as the rationale of its owner; `adr-governance-not-available` is the detail when the run evaluates no ADR governance.

qualityEntry.description: One quality scenario with the verdict of its own mode. The three modes are never merged into one score.

qualityAreaEntry.description: The coverage of one quality area: its scenarios with their verdicts and the findings (sensitivity points, risks, tradeoffs) that concern it. An area without a scenario is `no-scenario`, never a pass; a required one is a violation.

renderedEntry.description: One rendered source: what rendered it, what it read and gave, how complete it is. Digests and counts only, never a rendered value.

planEntry.description: One plan. It is shown whatever its binding says; `admissible` says whether a mandatory claim may rest on it. A plan is never evidence of a deployment.

evaluationEntry.description: One effective-policy query that a rule used, with the evaluator that answered it. The same rendered input gives the same answer and digest.

checkResultEntry.description: One check result with its admissibility. An inadmissible result stays listed with every reason and never gives a verdict. `coversNothing` is true for an explicitly empty `covers` list, which differs from a missing field.

testCandidate.description: A TESTS or TESTS_FILE association of the code graph. It is a candidate verification artifact and never evidence: it holds the test node and the tested node only (CBM 0.12.1 gives these edges no properties), and `nodes` is a suggested mapping that no verdict uses.

statementSummary.description: One statement file that was read: its digest, subjects, how far it is verified, and why it is not admissible when it is not.

assuranceToolchain.description: What the assurance evidence used besides Concordia: the renderers that ran, the cosign that verified, the evaluators, and the digests of the claim registry and of the trust contract.

crossings.description: One entry for each flow and dimension, sorted by flow and dimension.

reviewTrigger.description: A reason to review: the changed dependency, its class, the assessment that it reaches, and the shortest path. The action is `get review`.

analysisIncomplete.description: The limit that stopped an analysis: maxDepth, maxVisited, or maxSeconds.

controlResult.description: The result of one control: the worst verdict of its rules and its checks. A check with no admissible result makes the verdict unknown, and the reasons name the check.

evaluated.description: The rendered workloads and the planned resources that a binding maps to the subject, at the level rendered-or-evaluated. Never part of the declared chain; left out when none.
The level rendered-or-evaluated in this environment: the rendered sources and plans that hold evidence. Left out when the environment has none.

lineageStatementRef.description: One statement file: its path, the digest of its bytes, the producer whose signature verified, and its integrity.

lineageRejected.description: A statement that concerns the claim and cannot support it, with every reason.

lineageDigestSource.description: One digest of a drift comparison and where it comes from: the rendered image, a deployment record, or a workload observation.

lineageClaim.description: The result of one claim of the deployment evidence of an occurrence.

lineageEntry.description: The exact lineage claim for one rendered container occurrence, with the deployment evidence beside it. No SLSA level is derived or shown.

assessmentCurrency.description: The assessments that cover the depicted subject. not-evaluated lists none; otherwise the state is the most severe state of the listed assessments.

generatedFrom.description: The GENERATED_FROM link of a generated artifact; null for an authored view.
